$comment: What any good explanation of this PR says, written by a model from the PR's title, description and diff only (scripts/eval-assertions.ts). The eval grades each run against them. Delete one that is wrong; keep them stable so evals compare.

assertions.text: Says that admin users can export their family's data (accounts, transactions, trades, categories) as a downloadable zip of CSV files, which can be re-imported via CSV import.
Says that the export is generated asynchronously in a background job rather than in the web request, and the request returns immediately with a notice.
Says that a new FamilyExport record, belonging to a family, tracks each export's status through pending, processing, completed and failed.
Says that the generated zip is attached to the FamilyExport record as a file (Active Storage) and downloaded via a redirect to that attachment.
Says that access to exports is restricted to admin users, and exports are scoped to the current family.
Says that a data exporter class builds the zip in memory, scoped to the family, containing several CSV files plus an all.ndjson file with fuller data.
Says that the settings profile page shows an export button opening a modal, plus a lazy-loaded list of exports that auto-refreshes while exports are pending or processing.
Does not claim that the zip is built and streamed directly in the create request or that any family member can export.
